mapper.select: select rollout_type from pw_feature_flag where feature_key = #{featureKey}
select enabled from pw_user_feature_flag where feature_key = #{featureKey} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into pw_user_feature_flag (feature_key, user_id, enabled) values (#{featureKey}, #{userId}, CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) on conflict (user_id, feature_key) do update set enabled = excluded.enabled, updated_at = current_timestamp
